name: 78401 · Corp Christi, TX
findings: ZIP 78401 (Corp Christi) has 117 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78401 (Corp Christi) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
52% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78401 (Corp Christi) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 10.3 times the typical level).
